fields.name: nfcTablesEnabled
fields.attributes: @default(false) // secure NFC tags (NTAG 424 DNA) may be used to open a table's menu

fields.name: autoTableSessions
fields.attributes: @default(false) // the first valid guest order opens the table session; settling closes it

fields.name: category
fields.attributes: // grouping for the settings UI, e.g. "Orders", "Inventory"

fields.name: isSystem
fields.attributes: @default(true) // seeded default role vs. custom role

fields.name: pinHash
fields.attributes: // quick-switch PIN login on a shared terminal

fields.name: twoFactorRecoveryHashes
fields.attributes: @default([]) // bcrypt hashes of unused one-time recovery codes

fields.name: twoFactorLastStep
fields.attributes: // last accepted TOTP step: a code works once

fields.name: qrToken
fields.attributes: @unique // opaque token embedded in the table's QR code (Phase 2+)

fields.name: quantity
fields.attributes: @db.Decimal(12, 3) // USABLE quantity per recipe batch, in `unit`

fields.name: price
fields.attributes: @db.Decimal(12, 2) // tax-inclusive selling price (see nodedr-pos GST lesson in ARCHITECTURE.md)

fields.name: orderNumber
fields.attributes: // human-readable, sequential per branch per day

fields.name: taxAmount
fields.attributes: @default(0) @db.Decimal(12, 2) // informational breakup only — see ARCHITECTURE.md inclusive-pricing note

fields.name: portion
fields.attributes: // HALF | FULL | CUSTOM as ordered; null for plain items

fields.name: amount
fields.attributes: @db.Decimal(12, 2) // applied to the bill (net of change)

fields.name: method
fields.attributes: // how the refund was issued back to the guest

fields.name: secret
fields.attributes: // sealed (auth/totp.ts sealSecret); shown in full once

fields.name: reference
fields.attributes: @default("") // "" not null, so the unique key dedupes re-imports

fields.name: externalAccountId
fields.attributes: // merchant / outlet id on the other platform

fields.name: testKeys
fields.attributes: // names of the fields that are set, never values

fields.name: unitCost
fields.attributes: @db.Decimal(14, 4) // cost per finished unit of the primary output

fields.name: token
fields.attributes: @unique // in the display's URL; read-only access to what is shown

fields.name: idleSeconds
fields.attributes: @default(45) // a half-finished order with no change this long returns to adverts

fields.name: terminalId
fields.attributes: // null = every terminal of the branch

fields.name: durationSec
fields.attributes: // images only; null = the terminal's default

fields.name: openedById
fields.attributes: // null when the first valid guest order opened it (automatic sessions)

fields.name: metaKeySealed
fields.attributes: // decrypts the mirrored UID + counter (SDMMetaRead key)

fields.name: replacesId
fields.attributes: // the tag record this one replaced

fields.name: baseOutputQty
fields.attributes: @db.Decimal(12, 3) // good output this recipe makes, in the output item's stock unit

firestoreMigrationNotes: This is an exact source-schema inventory, not an approved final Firestore design.
Prisma scalar fields, optionality, defaults, unique constraints, indexes and relations must be reviewed before selecting document boundaries.
Prisma relations are recorded as field types/attributes and @@ constraints; references must be migrated to explicit document paths or stable IDs.
Do not mechanically translate Decimal, DateTime, Json, relation or nullable fields without defining precision, timestamp, serialization and access semantics.
